text:
Steven Stamkos is 36 and still doing the thing he has always done better than almost anyone. He has 11 goals in 19 games, 12 power-play points and seven goals in his last ten, and this month a Yahoo Sports headline marked him entering the all-time top five for power-play goals. Last season he scored 42 for Nashville, and this season's pace looks a lot like it.

The chances are genuine. His individual expected goals per 60 minutes is 1.25, a touch above last season. The finishing is the part running hot: 11 goals on 7.3 expected, a 23% shooting rate against 20% last year, and that rarely holds for a full season. His goals have also mattered. By our wins-added measure, which credits each goal by how much it moved the odds of winning, he ranks fifth of 521 skaters, almost a full win above what goals from those chances would usually be worth. Our projection range runs from 31 to 48 goals, centred on 39. He is the finisher on a team that has won six straight.
headline: Stamkos at 36: real chances, a hot finishing rate
